diagnostics.message: Two-group MGA v4 reports Group A/Group B structural paths, R-squared values, outer loadings, outer weights, and A-minus-B differences. Inference uses a canonical deterministic two-tailed fixed partition plan shared with MICOM v4.

Two-group permutation MGA v4 re-estimates paths, outer loadings, and outer weights using one fixed indexed size-preserving partition plan and reports two-tailed A-minus-B evidence without replacement retries.

MICOM v4 uses the same fixed partition identities for Steps 2 and 3. Step 1 records explicit researcher review; translation, coding meaning, and substantive indicator equivalence are not inferred from data.
The v4 partition ledger retained every requested attempt: Step 2/MGA had 19 failed rows and Step 3 had 0; no replacement retries were performed.
